description: You are a Cloud Systems Architect at a SaaS company that is migrating its monolithic web application to AWS. The VP of Engineering needs an Architecture Review Board (ARB) submission document, which requires a formal AWS cloud architecture diagram created in Wondershare EdrawMax. Design a production-grade, highly available 3-tier web application architecture deployed across two AWS Availability Zones. The diagram must depict clearly separated tiers — Presentation (web), Application (logic), and Data — along with the AWS networking infrastructure that connects them (VPC, subnets, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway, route tables as applicable). Include representative AWS service components such as load balancers, compute instances, managed database services, and object storage. Use AWS-specific shape icons from EdrawMax's AWS library where available, or clearly labeled shapes when not. The document must contain at least two pages: Page 1 is the Primary Region architecture; Page 2 is a Disaster Recovery (DR) or Multi-Region failover architecture showing how the system recovers from an AZ or region failure. Apply a consistent professional theme. Save the completed diagram as '/home/ga/aws_cloud_architecture.eddx'.
